name: EMFACE
intro: Non-invasive support for facial muscle tone and underlying structure, with no downtime and no recovery period.
imageAlt: Treatment handpiece above the brow, close-up
statement: Non-invasive support for *facial muscle tone and structure,* no downtime.
how: EMFACE combines radiofrequency and muscle stimulation in one applicator, with no needles and no downtime. We use it as the ongoing-maintenance step between more intensive courses.
suits: Patients with mild to moderate concerns who want a considered option without surgery.
notSuitable: Active skin infections, certain pigmentary conditions, pacemakers or implanted devices, or pregnancy.
assessed: Skin condition, laxity and any contraindicating conditions are reviewed in consultation.
before: Skin is cleansed and a topical anaesthetic applied to minimise discomfort.
during: The device is passed across the treatment area, with settings adjusted to your skin and goals.
after: Mild redness and swelling are expected for a short period afterwards.
risks: Risks may include prolonged redness, pigment changes or, rarely, infection; discussed in full at consultation.
